bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks and the cumulative forms.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: During a treatment session a patient asks the physical therapist assistant (PTA) to add an intervention not in the plan of care. The PTA should:

options.text: Contact the supervising physical therapist before adding it
options.rationale: Correct: the PTA works under the plan of care and must involve the supervising PT to change it.

options.text: Add the intervention because the patient requested it
options.rationale: Patient request does not authorise working outside the plan of care.
Discharge is not indicated and is not the PTA's independent decision.
The PTA can continue authorised interventions; refusal is not warranted.

items.explanation: Correct: the PTA works under the plan of care and must involve the supervising PT to change it.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: A patient's heart rate and blood pressure rise sharply and the patient reports dizziness during exercise. The most appropriate immediate action is to:

options.text: Stop the activity and monitor the patient
options.rationale: Correct: an abnormal physiological response with symptoms warrants stopping and monitoring.
Increasing intensity would worsen the abnormal response.

options.text: Ignore it as a normal training effect
options.rationale: Dizziness with a sharp haemodynamic change is not a normal response to continue through.

options.text: Document it at the end of the week
options.rationale: The response requires immediate action, not delayed documentation.

items.explanation: Correct: an abnormal physiological response with symptoms warrants stopping and monitoring.

items.stem: Which TWO actions are consistent with safe therapeutic-exercise progression under a plan of care?

options.text: Advancing load only when the current level is tolerated without adverse response
options.rationale: Correct: progression follows tolerance and stays within the plan of care.

options.text: Reassessing the patient's response before progressing
Doubling resistance each visit regardless of response
options.rationale: Fixed aggressive increases ignore tolerance and are unsafe.

options.text: Changing the plan of care goals independently
options.rationale: Goal changes are the supervising PT's responsibility.

items.explanation: Correct: progression follows tolerance and stays within the plan of care.
